body:
Closes #15 (phase A).

Status files for 7 accepted kit specs (index, overview, quality, remote, roles, skills, templates; 39 criteria), created with `octo-feather-spec-status init <spec> bfb3a92`, then one `just qc` per spec with all its ids; only passes flip to built (ADR 0021, ADR 0022). Status-only lane: no code, spec or contract edits. No status files for comms or issue-lifecycle (phase B, after #8).

Baseline qc failures are product gaps, not factory findings (owner, 2026-10-19); they open gap lanes, never a correction lane.

## QC results (20/39 built, all pr 16)

| run | spec | passed | seconds | judged head | qc commit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | overview | 0/4 | 98 | b3aee7a | none (all fail) |
| 2 | index | 1/1 | 88 | b3aee7a | 01d86a3 |
| 3 | skills | 2/5 | 255 | 01d86a3 | 2574951 |
| 4 | templates | 5/6 | 269 | 2574951 | e4a04c3 |
| 5 | quality | 2/7 | 201 | e4a04c3 | 2fbd899 |
| 6 | remote | 1/7 | 125 | 2fbd899 | 764c710 |
| 7 | roles | 9/9 | 348 | 764c710 | f5f90b8 |

Built: index `acceptance-index-links`; skills `acceptance-only-listed` `acceptance-notice`; templates `acceptance-fresh-green` `acceptance-type-error` `acceptance-layer-break` `acceptance-cli-json` `acceptance-target-agents-md`; quality `acceptance-gate-green` `acceptance-public-surfaces`; remote `acceptance-login-gate`; roles all 9 (`acceptance-tab-headless-same` `acceptance-family-guard` `acceptance-unknown-key` `acceptance-unresolved-skill` `acceptance-unknown-model` `acceptance-no-skill-leak` `acceptance-director-tools` `acceptance-supervise-layout` `acceptance-worker-in-lane`).

Every commit after b3aee7a is a `just qc` status commit touching exactly one status file; built set equals the reports' pass set. Judge `openai/gpt-6.1-sol`; kit judge files (`octo-feather-qc`, `pi-role`, `code-reviewer.md`, `principle-prove-it-works`) unchanged b65799c..f99279b across all runs. Reports: `~/.local/state/octo-feather/qc/gh15-<slug>/<judged head>.json` (per-slug dir, finding 15).

## Review

Fresh code-reviewer (`openai/gpt-6.1-sol`) on f5f90b8 vs b65799c: CLEAR, 0 blocking, 0 notes. Checked: only the 7 status files changed; 39 ids match the spec anchors; accepted_commit bfb3a92; spec HTML unchanged; 20 pass -> built/pr 16, 19 fail -> planned/null; each qc commit touches one status file, its parent is the judged head, its bytes match qc output; `just check` green.

## Trimmed

Trimmed for this fixture, unread by merge-ask (it reads only a `## Merge ask` section, which PR #16 lacks): Acceptance evidence; QC sandbox (finding 17); Gap list (baseline qc failures; every one stays planned).
